idea.name: Invoice follow-up helper (synthetic example)
idea.problem: Some freelancers may forget when to follow up on late invoices

evidence.author: sample-user-a
evidence.claim: I forget to send reminders for overdue client invoices.
evidence.observation: Synthetic user says late invoices are tracked in a spreadsheet.

evidence.author: sample-user-b
evidence.claim: I forget to remind clients when their invoices are overdue.
evidence.observation: Synthetic user says they manually check payment status and reminders each week.

evidence.author: sample-user-c
evidence.claim: I spend too much time reconciling different tax rates on invoices.
evidence.observation: Synthetic user talks about tax-rate reconciliation, a different problem.

evidence.author: sample-user-a
evidence.claim: The author uses a spreadsheet for reminders.

evidence.author: sample-user-d
evidence.claim: My accounting software already sends reliable overdue invoice reminders.

evidence.author: sample-vendor
evidence.claim: A sample product claims to automate late invoice reminders.
evidence.observation: Synthetic competitor placeholder; verify real alternatives for an actual idea.
